headline: MercadoLibre Q3 Profit Hits $448 Million as Margins Tighten
summary: MercadoLibre reported a third-quarter profit of US$448 million on a 45% revenue increase. Operating margins declined to 6.3% due to rising shipping and warehouse costs.
why: MercadoLibre is the largest e-commerce platform in Latin America and a key indicator for regional consumer spending and tech growth.

impacts.name: MercadoLibre
impacts.why: Strong revenue growth is offset by margin compression, leading to mixed market reactions.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Investors often weigh top-line growth against margin performance, which can cause volatility in high-growth tech stocks.
